note: Per-tree vertical-dip baselines for the tree-shadow frame check, from the verified shadowless build (v0.6.6, master 93a0145; mean of gate runs 2026-11-10T06-29-06 and 2026-11-10T06-38-10 where a tree was sampled twice). The dip is plate-biased per tree (painted ground under a grove tree reads darker than 30px further down-screen), so an absolute floor cannot separate plate bias from a real shadow ellipse. On shadowed builds (v0.6.4/v0.6.5) the matched-tree MEDIAN delta was -0.109/-0.083; on the shadowless build it is ~0. The gate FAILs when the median delta < -0.05 or any single tree drops > 0.12. Re-baseline ONLY on a build verified good by eye: run the gate, confirm the frames, then average the pooled dips from report.json into this file.
